description: A luxurious oceanfront terrace or pool deck photographed at deep dusk, the sea and distant coastline silhouetted against a deep periwinkle-blue sky. The terrace surface is large-format smooth grey-white concrete or stone pavers, wide and uninterrupted. Two matching outdoor sun loungers with a thin matte black tubular frame and thick white cushioned pads sit side by side, each dressed with a single matte black square throw cushion. The pool edge is barely visible at the far right of the frame, hinting at an infinity edge with the ocean beyond. Dense tropical foliage — dark-leafed trees and shrubs — frames the right side of the scene, their silhouettes merging into the dusk sky. Through a large sliding glass door behind the lounge chairs, a softly lit interior living space is visible — white upholstered furniture and a warm interior glow hinting at a calm, luxurious domestic space. The contrast between the cool blue dusk sky, the dark silhouetted coastline, and the warm white glow from the interior creates a deeply serene, resort-like atmosphere. A warm, glowing sculptural form stands between the two lounge chairs, its luminous white body casting a gentle warm radiance across the terrace deck and the near faces of the chair cushions. Camera is at a low-to-seated eye-level, approximately 3–4 feet, shooting a wide three-quarter view of the terrace scene. The lens is moderately wide, capturing both lounge chairs, the pool edge, the glass door, and the ocean view. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
